per_query.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 'profitable' ELSE 'loss_making' END AS profit_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss != 0 AND revenue > 0 GROUP BY profit_status

SELECT CASE WHEN remuneration_policy LIKE '%Mixed%' THEN 'Mixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS pay_policy, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE revenue >= 100000000 AND remuneration_policy != '' GROUP BY pay_policy

SELECT CASE WHEN dividend_per_share > 0 THEN 'pays_dividend' ELSE 'no_dividend' END AS dividend_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' AND dividend_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dividend_status

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash, AVG(net_assets) AS avg_net_assets FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND total_debt IS NOT NULL AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL AND net_assets IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(net_profit_or_loss) AS avg_profit FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' AND exchange_code != '' AND revenue > 0 AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family, exchange_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT CASE WHEN remuneration_policy LIKE '%Mixed%' THEN 'Mixed' WHEN remuneration_policy != '' THEN 'Other' END AS pay_policy, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE remuneration_policy != '' GROUP BY pay_policy

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, CASE WHEN business_segments_num >= 3 THEN 'three_or_more' ELSE 'one_or_two' END AS segment_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family, segment_band

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, AVG(business_segments_num) AS avg_segments FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN remuneration_policy LIKE '%Mixed%' THEN 'Mixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS pay_policy, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(earnings_per_share) AS avg_eps FROM finance WHERE remuneration_policy != '' AND revenue > 0 AND earnings_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pay_policy

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, AVG(earnings_per_share) AS avg_eps FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' AND earnings_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT major_equity_changes, AVG(the_highest_ownership_stake) AS avg_top_stake FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes IN ('Yes', 'No') AND the_highest_ownership_stake IS NOT NULL GROUP BY major_equity_changes

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss > 0 AND total_debt IS NOT NULL AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE net_assets > 0 AND net_profit_or_loss > 0 AND auditor != '' GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT major_equity_changes, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' OR auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' GROUP BY major_equity_changes
SELECT major_equity_changes, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY major_equity_changes

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, SUM(cash_reserves) AS total_cash FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exchange_family

per_query.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%oncology%' THEN 'oncology' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%neuroscience%' THEN 'neuroscience' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%immunology%' OR LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%microbiology%' THEN 'immuno_micro' WHEN LOWER(i.research_fields) LIKE '%clinical_research%' THEN 'clinical_research' WHEN i.research_fields != '' THEN 'other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' AND i.research_fields != '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(treatments) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'uses_injection' ELSE 'no_injection' END AS injection_status, CASE WHEN LOWER(treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN 'uses_oral' ELSE 'no_oral' END AS oral_status, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease WHERE treatments != '' GROUP BY injection_status, oral_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, CASE WHEN manufacturer != '' THEN 'known_manufacturer' ELSE 'manufacturer_unknown' END AS mfr_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug dr WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family, mfr_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' THEN dr.id END) AS oral_disease_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.prognosis != '' THEN d.id END) AS prognosis_recorded_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family

SELECT CASE WHEN manufacturer != '' THEN 'known_manufacturer' ELSE 'manufacturer_unknown' END AS mfr_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oral_count, SUM(CASE WHEN prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rx_only_count FROM drug GROUP BY mfr_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug dr WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' AND dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY route_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(pathogenesis) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(pathogenesis) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN pathogenesis != '' THEN 'other' END AS path_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease WHERE pathogenesis != '' GROUP BY path_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS institution_count FROM institution i JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE LOWER(d.treatments) LIKE '%oral_medication%' AND i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN dr.id END) AS oral_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN dr.id END) AS tablet_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family
SELECT CASE WHEN manufacturer != '' THEN 'known_manufacturer' ELSE 'manufacturer_unknown' END AS mfr_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug GROUP BY mfr_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(unsuitable_population) LIKE '%pregnant%' THEN 'mentions_pregnancy' WHEN unsuitable_population != '' THEN 'other_restriction' END AS restriction_group, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE unsuitable_population != '' GROUP BY restriction_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, CASE WHEN international_collaboration != '' THEN 'has_collaboration' ELSE 'no_collaboration_recorded' END AS collab_status, COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institution i WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type, collab_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.prognosis) LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' WHEN d.prognosis != '' THEN 'other_prognosis' END AS prognosis_group, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.administration_route != '' AND d.prognosis != '' GROUP BY route_family, prognosis_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN 'USA' WHEN i.institution_country != '' THEN 'outside_USA' END AS country_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.disease_type != '' AND i.institution_country != '' GROUP BY type_family, country_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.institution_country LIKE '%USA%' THEN dr.id END) AS usa_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN dr.id END) AS oral_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(prognosis) LIKE '%high_mortality%' THEN 'high_mortality' WHEN LOWER(prognosis) LIKE '%chronic%' THEN 'chronic' WHEN prognosis != '' THEN 'other' END AS prognosis_group, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM disease WHERE prognosis != '' GROUP BY prognosis_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(administration_route) LIKE '%intravenous%' OR LOWER(administration_route) LIKE '%subcutaneous%' THEN 'injectable_route' WHEN administration_route != '' THEN 'other_route' END AS route_group, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE administration_route != '' GROUP BY route_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' THEN 'tablet' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%injection%' THEN 'injection' WHEN LOWER(dr.pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%capsule%' THEN 'capsule' WHEN dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' THEN 'other' END AS form_family, COUNT(*) AS drug_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oral_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dr.manufacturer != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS known_mfr_count FROM drug dr WHERE dr.pharmaceutical_form != '' GROUP BY form_family

per_query.sql: SELECT first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed_count FROM legal WHERE first_judge IS NOT NULL AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE verdict = 'Approved' AND plaintiff_current_status != '' GROUP BY plaintiff_family

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2008 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN legal_basis_num <= 1 THEN '0_or_1' WHEN legal_basis_num <= 3 THEN '2_or_3' ELSE '4_or_more' END AS statute_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents, SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'Dismissed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed_count FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY statute_band

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status != '' AND defendant_current_status != '' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY plaintiff_family, defendant_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
SELECT first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE first_judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, CASE WHEN case_number >= 8 THEN 'precedent_heavy' ELSE 'precedent_light' END AS precedent_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, precedent_band

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status != '' GROUP BY plaintiff_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family, verdict_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, MAX(case_number) AS max_precedents FROM legal WHERE case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY case_family

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_number >= 10 THEN 'many_precedents' ELSE 'fewer_precedents' END AS precedent_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Civil Case' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY precedent_band

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status = 'Government' GROUP BY case_family

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status = 'Company' AND defendant_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') GROUP BY verdict_family
SELECT hearing_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2009 GROUP BY hearing_year
SELECT first_judge, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE first_judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY first_judge

demonstrated: DocETL finishes all 16 Finan queries; each query maps the same 7 doc_ids {9,10,18,69,70,78,93} then SQLite. Current source tree has 100 txt files; the runtime dataset snapshot is unavailable.
QuWARTS query-witness at θ=1,381,827 attempted 805 tasks, accepted 96, filled 0 additional empty bags (20 empty remain).
DocETL mean call is ~12k tokens (full document + multi-attribute schema). QuWARTS witness/schema jobs are ~1.7k tokens (one condition or cell).
DocETL empty bags: from query_tables pred_rows==0. QuWARTS empty bags stay at 20/20 programs.
DocETL groups/counts/avgs are SQLite over extracted columns, not LLM reduce.
hypotheses_not_demonstrated: Whether DocETL retrieval/context is better: no retrieval operator exists in the frozen run.
Whether DocETL batching of several documents per call occurred: runner default batch_size is 1; per-call payloads are unavailable.
Exact retry counts per document: only query-level llm_calls exist.

decision.choice: DocETL completes queries rather than spreading coverage
decision.largest_mechanism_quwarts_lacks: Query-complete extract-then-SQLite: every Finan query gets a multi-attribute map over the frozen 7-document bag and a deterministic SQL aggregate, instead of spending the same θ on many ~1.7k-token witness/cell jobs that leave programs incomplete.
also_demonstrated_but_secondary: DocETL directly generates aggregates/groups via SQLite (not LLM).
DocETL packs several attributes per document into one call (~12k tokens) vs QuWARTS ~1.7k per cell/witness.
rejected: DocETL uses materially better retrieval/context — no retrieval artifacts.
DocETL batches more evidence per call — batch_size default 1; no per-call payload log.
